sections.title: 一、听力理解 (第一段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第一段对话,完成第1、2小题。

audio.text:
Tom: Hi, Amy. Where did you go last summer?
Amy: I went to Qinghai Lake with my parents. It's in western China.
Tom: Is it big?
Amy: Yes, it's China's largest saltwater lake. The water is blue.
Tom: What did you do there?
Amy: I rode a bike along the lake. The view was wonderful. I saw many birds.
Tom: Sounds great. I will go there with my grandparents this year.

questions.translation: 艾米和谁一起去了青海湖？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Amy: I went to Qinghai Lake with my parents.' 可知，艾米和父母一起去了青海湖，故选 B。
questions.prompt: Who did Amy go to Qinghai Lake with?

questions.translation: 艾米在那里做了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Amy: I rode a bike along the lake. The view was wonderful. I saw many birds.' 可知，艾米在那里看到了许多鸟，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What did Amy do there?
options: Amy took photos of the lake.
Amy rowed a boat on the lake.

sections.title: 二、听力理解 (第二段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第二段对话,完成第3、4、5小题。

audio.text:
Lucy: Hi, Mike. My British friend is coming to China. She loves nature. She likes mountains, rivers, and quiet places. Where should I take her?
Mike: Hi, Lucy. You can take her to Guilin. It has beautiful mountains, clear rivers, and quiet villages nearby. It's perfect for her.
Lucy: Can she do outdoor activities there?
Mike: Sure. She can take a boat trip on the river, ride a bike, or just walk and enjoy the views.
Lucy: Great! I'll tell her about Guilin. Thanks, Mike.

questions.translation: 为什么迈克推荐桂林？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Mike: It has beautiful mountains, clear rivers, and quiet villages nearby. It's perfect for her.' 可知，因为桂林拥有美丽的自然风光，故选 B。
questions.prompt: Why does Mike recommend (推荐) Guilin?
options: Because the food in Guilin is delicious.
Because it has beautiful natural places.
Because it is famous in China.

questions.translation: 露西的朋友可以通过什么方式欣赏桂林的美景？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 'Mike: Sure. She can take a boat trip on the river, ride a bike, or just walk and enjoy the views.' 可知，可以乘船游览漓江，故选 C。
questions.prompt: What can Lucy's friend do to enjoy the views of Guilin?
options: See wild animals in the zoo.
Take a boat trip on the river.

questions.translation: 这段对话主要关于什么？
questions.explanation: 对话主要是露西为即将来中国旅游的英国朋友咨询迈克并挑选合适的旅行地点，故选 B。
questions.prompt: What is the dialogue mainly about?
options: Helping a British friend find the way.
Choosing a travel place for a British friend.
Introducing the beautiful scenery (风景) of Guilin.

sections.title: 三、对话填空 (Get ready & Start up)
sections.instruction: 读对话,选择最佳选项,将对话补充完整,将其标号填在横线上。

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Hi, Lucy. What kind of place in nature do you like?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Me too. Have you ever been to Lijiang?

dialogue.speaker: Lucy
dialogue.text: I saw the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain. It's very high and white. I also walked in the old town. There were many small rivers and bridges.

wordbank: Yes. I went to Lijiang last summer.
I really want to go there one day.
It's a great place to relax and enjoy nature.

questions.translation: 我最喜欢山。
questions.explanation: 上文问喜欢大自然中的哪种景观，下文Tom说'Me too'，选项C 'I like mountains best.' 符合语境。

questions.translation: 是的。我去年夏天去了丽江。
questions.explanation: 上文问'Have you ever been to Lijiang?'，回答为肯定回答加具体时间，选项D符合语境。
questions.answer: Yes. I went to Lijiang last summer.

questions.translation: 你在那里看到了什么？
questions.explanation: 下文Lucy详细回答了看到的玉龙雪山和古镇等景色，故问句为选项B 'What did you see there?'。

questions.translation: 我真想有一天去那里。
questions.explanation: Tom称赞风景美丽，并表达想去的愿望，选项A 'I really want to go there one day.' 符合语境。
questions.answer: I really want to go there one day.

questions.translation: 那是一个放松和享受大自然的好地方。
questions.explanation: Lucy推荐Tom一定要去，并总结该地的优点，选项E符合语境。
questions.answer: It's a great place to relax and enjoy nature.

options: Yes. I went to Lijiang last summer.
I really want to go there one day.
It's a great place to relax and enjoy nature.

sections.title: 四、听力判断 (Speed up)
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据短文内容判断句子是否与所听到的内容一致,一致的在括号中用“T”表示,不一致的用“F”表示。

audio.text: Lucy and her family often go to a nature park. It has a big, deep and blue lake. At the lake, there is a wonderful waterfall about 30 metres wide. There is also a large green grassland. Lucy likes to run there and sometimes sees horses there. She feels happy in this beautiful place and loves the natural wonders.

questions.translation: 露西和她的家人经常去一个自然公园。
questions.explanation: 听力原文明确指出 'Lucy and her family often go to a nature park.'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: Lucy and her family often go to a nature park.

questions.translation: 公园里的湖又深又蓝。
questions.explanation: 听力原文原句为 'It has a big, deep and blue lake.'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: The lake in the park is deep and blue.

questions.translation: 湖边的瀑布有40米宽。
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出瀑布大约30米宽（about 30 metres wide），而不是40米，故为 F。
questions.prompt: The waterfall at the lake is 40 metres wide.

questions.translation: 露西有时在草地上放风筝。
questions.explanation: 听力原文指出露西喜欢在草地上奔跑并有时看见马（sometimes sees horses），并未提及放风筝，故为 F。
questions.prompt: Lucy sometimes flies a kite on the grassland.

questions.translation: 露西喜欢待在那里，并且热爱自然奇观。
questions.explanation: 听力原文最后指出 'She feels happy in this beautiful place and loves the natural wonders.'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: Lucy enjoys staying there and loves the natural wonders.

sections.title: 五、完形填空 (Speed up)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文,根据短文内容,选择恰当的单词,将其标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage: Xu Xiake was [1] great traveller in ancient China. He lived in Ming Dynasty. He [2] across China. Even when the trip was [3] he never gave up. Later, his words along the way became a book called *The Travel Diaries of Xu Xiake*. Xu Xiake shows that loving to learn and never giving up can [4] [5] us find amazing things.

questions.translation: 徐霞客是中国古代一位伟大的旅行家。
questions.explanation: great以辅音音素开头，冠词使用 a，故选 A。

questions.translation: 他走遍了中国各地。
questions.explanation: 讲述历史人物过去的事迹，使用一般过去时 travelled，故选 A。

questions.translation: 即使旅程艰难，他也从未放弃。
questions.explanation: 根据后半句 'he never gave up'（从未放弃）可知旅途非常艰难（hard），故选 B。

questions.translation: 情态动词can后接动词原形help。
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 后面接动词原形 help，故选 A。

questions.translation: 动词后接宾格代词us。
questions.explanation: 动词 help 后面跟人称代词宾格 us 作宾语，故选 A。

sections.title: 六、听力填空 (Fuel up)
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据短文内容补全信息。

audio.text: Hello, my name is Phoebe. P-H-O-E-B-E, Phoebe. I'm twelve years old. Last summer, I went to Tianchi Lake on Changbai Mountain. It is the deepest lake in China. The deepest point is about 373 metres. I was very interested in the beautiful view. The lake is a great natural wonder. I want to go there again next year.

sections.passage:
# Tianchi Lake Trip
* **Name:** [1]
* **Age:** [2]
* **What she learned and felt:**
  - Tianchi Lake is the [3] lake in China.
  - She was very [4] in the beautiful view.
  - The lake is a great natural [5].

questions.translation: 姓名：Phoebe
questions.explanation: 听力原文明确拼写为 Phoebe（P-H-O-E-B-E）。
questions.prompt: Name

questions.translation: 年龄：12岁
questions.explanation: 听力原文提到 'I'm twelve years old.'，故填 12 或 twelve。
questions.prompt: Age

questions.translation: 最深的：deepest
questions.explanation: 听力原文提到 'It is the deepest lake in China.'，故填 deepest。
questions.prompt: Tianchi Lake is the _____ lake in China.

questions.translation: 感兴趣的：interested
questions.explanation: 听力原文提到 'I was very interested in the beautiful view.'，故填 interested。
questions.prompt: She was very _____ in the beautiful view.

questions.translation: 奇观：wonder
questions.explanation: 听力原文提到 'The lake is a great natural wonder.'，故填 wonder。
questions.prompt: The lake is a great natural _____.

sections.title: 七、阅读判断 (Qomolangma: On Top of the World)
sections.instruction: 阅读 Qomolangma: On Top of the World 这本书的目录 (Contents), 判断句子是否与其内容相符, 相符的用“T”表示, 不相符的用“F”表示。
sections.passage:
# Qomolangma: On Top of the World (Contents)

| Chapter | Title | Page |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | Mount Qomolangma | 5 |
| 2 | Preparing for the Climb | 8 |
| 3 | The Climb | 10 |
| 4 | Sherpas (夏尔巴人) | 14 |
| 5 | The First to the Top | 16 |
| 6 | Climbers | 18 |
| 7 | Dangers | 21 |

questions.translation: 书中共有九个章节。
questions.explanation: 从目录可知本书共有 7 个章节，而不是 9 个，故为 F。
questions.prompt: There are nine chapters in the book.

questions.translation: 如果你想了解珠穆朗玛峰，请阅读第8页。
questions.explanation: 第8页是第2章 'Preparing for the Climb'（攀登准备），第1章介绍珠峰在第5页，故为 F。
questions.prompt: If you want to know about Mount Qomolangma, read page 8.

questions.translation: 我们可以读到人们是如何攀登珠穆朗玛峰的。
questions.explanation: 第3章标题为 'The Climb'（攀登过程），可以读到攀登过程，故为 T。
questions.prompt: We can read about how people climb Mount Qomolangma.

questions.translation: 我们可以从书中了解夏尔巴人。
questions.explanation: 第4章专门介绍 'Sherpas (夏尔巴人)'，故为 T。
questions.prompt: We can learn about Sherpas from the book.

questions.translation: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山峰。
questions.explanation: 书名副标题为 'On Top of the World'（世界之巅），珠峰是世界最高峰，故为 T。
questions.prompt: Qomolangma is the world's highest mountain.

sections.title: 八、阅读理解 A (China's Colourful Soil)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文 China's Colourful Soil (土壤), 根据短文内容选择最佳选项, 将相应的标号填入括号内。
sections.passage:
# China's Colourful Soil

China has different colours of soil. Each kind of soil is in different places and is good for growing different plants.

Paddy soil is great for growing rice. It looks green when wet. You can mostly find it in southern China. It covers about 25 percent (百分比) of China's farmland.

In places like Jiangxi, Hunan and Yunnan, the soil is often red. It is rich in iron (富含铁元素). Tea trees, oranges and bamboo grow well on this land.

The Loess Plateau (黄土高原) in northwestern China has yellow, loose (疏松的) soil. It's good for growing herbs (草药).

White soil is full of salt. You will often find it in northern China or near the sea. It's home to Euphrates poplar trees (胡杨树).

questions.translation: 你主要能在哪里找到绿色水稻土？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段 'You can mostly find it in southern China.' 可知主要在中国南部，故选 B。
questions.prompt: You can mostly find green soil in _____.

questions.translation: 红土壤富含什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段 'It is rich in iron.' 可知红土壤富含铁元素，故选 C。
questions.prompt: Red soil is rich in _____.

questions.translation: 根据文章内容，下列哪项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段 'The Loess Plateau in northwestern China has yellow, loose soil. It's good for growing herbs.' 可知黄色土壤适合种植草药，故选 B。
questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: Green soil covers 52% of China's farmland.
Yellow soil is good for growing herbs.
White soil is good for growing rice.

questions.translation: 如果农民想种植茶树，哪种颜色的土壤是最佳选择？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段 'Tea trees, oranges and bamboo grow well on this land [red soil].' 可知红土壤适合种植茶树，故选 B。
questions.prompt: If a farmer wants to grow tea trees, which colour of soil is the best choice?

questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍了中国不同颜色的土壤及其适宜种植的植物与用途，故选 A。
questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Different soils in China and their uses.
Many kinds of plants in southern China.

sections.title: 九、阅读理解 B (A Bite of the Silk Road)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文 A Bite of the Silk Road, 根据其内容选择最佳选项, 将相应的标号填入括号内。
sections.passage:
# A Bite of the Silk Road

The weather is getting hot. Want to have some cucumber with mashed garlic (蒜泥黄瓜)? When you enjoy this tasty summer dish, don't forget to say "thanks" to one person—Zhang Qian.

Zhang Qian lived during the Han Dynasty. He was an early traveller on the Silk Road and brought many new foods and other things to China. What is the "Silk Road"?

The Silk Road was a long road. It connected (连接) China and Central Asia (中亚), and even Eastern Europe (东欧).

### Where is this dish from?
Cucumbers came from South Asia (南亚). In early times, Chinese people called it "hugua (胡瓜)". "Hu" means "foreign". Later, its name changed to "huanggua (黄瓜)". In some places, people also call it "qinggua (青瓜)".

What about garlic? Its home is in Central Asia. Zhang Qian brought it to China about 2,000 years ago. Garlic can make many dishes taste better. It kills germs and is good for our health.

questions.translation: 张骞生活在哪个朝代？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段 'Zhang Qian lived during the Han Dynasty.' 可知生活在汉朝，故选 A。
questions.prompt: Zhang Qian lived during _____.

questions.translation: “胡瓜”中的“胡”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段 'In early times, Chinese people called it "hugua". "Hu" means "foreign".' 可知意为“外国的/外来的”，故选 A。
questions.prompt: What does "hu" mean in "hugua"? It means _____.

questions.translation: 大蒜来自哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段 'What about garlic? Its home is in Central Asia.' 可知大蒜原产自中亚，故选 C。
questions.prompt: Where did garlic come from?

questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍了张骞以及通过丝绸之路引入中国的食物（黄瓜和大蒜等），故选 B。
questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: How to cook a tasty summer dish.
Zhang Qian and the foods from the Silk Road.
The history of vegetables in China.
